notes: SmartAsset gives no data year for Miami-Dade 0.76% (Florida statewide 0.75%). Insurance is the Florida statewide average; no Miami city figure on Insurify, and Miami-area premiums are likely higher than the state average (hurricane exposure); condo owners pay much less (HO-6) but face HOA/master-policy costs. Cross-checks seen: FRED/Realtor.com median listing price Miami CBSA $490,000 (2026-09, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/data/MEDLISPRI33100.txt); Apartment List Miami metro median rent $1,811 (Oct 2026, https://www.apartmentlist.com/rent-report/fl/miami). transfer_taxes.name: Florida documentary stamp tax on deeds (Miami-Dade rate)
transfer_taxes.source_title: Florida DOR: Documentary Stamp Tax overview (tutorial)
transfer_taxes.notes: $0.60 per $100 in Miami-Dade. Plus $0.45 per $100 discretionary surtax that does NOT apply to deeds conveying only a single-family residence; condos/other property pay 0.60% + 0.45% = 1.05%. Seller customarily pays.

transfer_taxes.name: Florida documentary stamp tax on mortgage/note
transfer_taxes.source_title: Florida DOR: Documentary Stamp Tax overview (tutorial)
transfer_taxes.notes: $0.35 per $100; no cap for recorded mortgages.

transfer_taxes.name: Florida nonrecurring intangible tax on mortgage
transfer_taxes.notes: 2 mills; lender liable, may pass to borrower.
